head: 1c24f289b
head_note: code only, uncompiled (orchestrator compiles every switch on and off, NV and AMD, host twins)

idn_pq_device_codebooks.note: lane postmerge-act-1 (2026-10-09): PROMOTED to the IDENTICAL default; -D MOJOLEARN_IDN_PQ_DEVICE_CODEBOOKS_OFF restores the per-subspace k-means fits; the old on-define is refused by the guard. Post-merge A/B, one run per arm: ivf-pq taxi NV 273.1->159.2 / AMD 143,778->195.3 ms; istella NV 1,535.5->1,018.3 / AMD timeout->853.8 ms; recall@10 istella 0.555->0.749, taxi 0.968->0.981 (cuVS 0.791 / 0.977); digests NV == AMD (925740284b istella, d6bed412ed taxi). Batched device Lloyd loop (pq_codebooks_device: strided seeds, 3 launches per iteration, one sync) with the pinned fold (ftz partial adds, identical_div centroid); host twin _codebooks_host_batched follows the same switch. Bits change vs the old default on NV, AMD and the host column together.

ivf_pq_one_upload_off.note: Rollback arm: the coarse build's rows are uploaded twice and the labels round-trip through the host. Default: resident coarse build with keep_rows hands dx, centres and labels to the residual step; no numpy->List copy under IVF_BUILD_FROM_POINTER.

idn_pq_lut_tiled_off.status: confirmed:postmerge-20261009 (nv2 v0996->v0995, amd a1131->a1136): tiled stays the default
idn_pq_lut_tiled_off.note: Rollback arm: pq_score_kernel (per-candidate pq_lut_entry when pq_dim x n_codes > LUT_MAX). Default: pq_score_tiled_kernel in IDENTICAL. Same words: ID check owed against the _OFF arm. CONFIRMED (lane postmerge-act-3, post-merge A/B on main a47bd9fb2): the _OFF arm is neutral, ivf-pq istella NV 1.00x / AMD 1.00x, taxi NV 1.04x / AMD 1.00x, same digests.

ivf_pq_resident_fit_off.note: Rollback arm: x_ann_ivf_pq_build_resident is not registered; fit downloads codes and the first search prepares the handle. Default: fit returns a resident handle; codes_ is exported on first read.

kmeans_live_cores_off.note: Rollback arm: the fused assignment grid from gpu_cores_for (108 NV / 110 AMD). Default on NVIDIA/AMD: MULTIPROCESSOR_COUNT (cached). Scheduling only.

ivf_idn_recluster_cap_off.bits_change: only when the k-means|| recluster ran past kmeans_n_iters; device and host columns together
ivf_idn_recluster_cap_off.status: confirmed:postmerge-20261009 (nv2 v0996->v0994, amd a1131->a1135): the cap stays the default
ivf_idn_recluster_cap_off.note: Rollback arm: the recluster runs up to KMeansParams.default()'s 300 iterations. Default: capped at the IVF build's kmeans_n_iters. Recall gate vs cuVS required. CONFIRMED (lane postmerge-act-3, post-merge A/B on main a47bd9fb2, k-means|| seeding): the _OFF arm is slower, ivf-pq istella NV 1.36x / AMD 1.49x, taxi NV 1.01x / AMD 1.02x (recall@10 istella +0.0016, taxi +0.0009). Under the strided-init default the recluster never runs; the cap matters only with MOJOLEARN_IVF_IDN_STRIDED_INIT_OFF.

ivf_idn_strided_init.status: promoted:postmerge-20261009 (nv2 v0996->v0993, amd a1131->a1134); confirmed:postmerge-20261010 (lane/postmerge-act-6; fg2 board-bridge A/B on main 0a7b206f1, one run per arm (nv2 L40S v1021-v1050, amd MI325X a1161-a1190; ratio = arm / fg2 default)): the strided coarse start stays the IDENTICAL default
ivf_idn_strided_init.note: lane postmerge-act-3 (2026-10-09): PROMOTED to the IDENTICAL default; -D MOJOLEARN_IVF_IDN_STRIDED_INIT_OFF restores k-means|| seeding; the old on-define is refused by the guard. Post-merge A/B on main a47bd9fb2, one run per arm: ivf-pq istella NV 1008.1->756.9 ms (0.75x) / AMD 853.1->542.2 (0.64x), recall@10 0.7489->0.8021 on both; taxi NV 157.2->100.0 (0.64x) / AMD 195.0->83.9 (0.43x), recall@10 0.98125 equal. Digests NV == AMD (istella 7a39a98cdca7dc6e, taxi 5c793de3ec021c64). Centre c = training row (c n_train) // n_lists (device gather; host the same rows), INIT_ARRAY. Bits change vs the old default on NV, AMD and the host column together. Makes ivf_idn_recluster_cap_off moot unless _OFF is set. CONFIRMED 2026-10-10: the _OFF arm (old start) is slower on ivf-flat, istella NV 2.33x / AMD 2.90x, taxi NV 2.60x / AMD 3.54x (its hashes are the old start's, as expected).

expanded:ivf-pq.route: IVFPQIndex.fit -> x_ann_ivf_pq_build_resident [ivf_pq_resident_fit_off] -> _ivf_pq_build_impl: coarse = ivf_flat_build_resident_host keep_rows [ivf_pq_one_upload_off; ivf_idn_strided_init (default), ivf_idn_recluster_cap_off, kmeans_live_cores_off] -> residual -> codebooks (pq_codebooks_device [idn_pq_device_codebooks] or per-subspace kmeans_fit_rows) -> encode; search -> ivf_scan_search score (pq_score_tiled_kernel [idn_pq_lut_tiled_off]) (A5 pq_scan_fused_kernel and B3 counting-sort layout deleted)

ann:ivf.route: IVFIndex.fit -> ivf_flat_build_resident (strided trainset, strided start [ivf_idn_strided_init (default; _OFF = k-means||), ivf_idn_recluster_cap_off] + lazy Lloyd with the fused assignment [kmeans_live_cores_off], predict, radix layout) -> handle
